note: Issue 443, patrons.md section 4. A patron whose specialty is experts offers one of his kind, once he thinks well enough of the PC and while some town has a library to receive him. Accepting is an Order to the patron; compliance decides whether he goes through with it, and ExpertGiftExecutor lands the man the month after in the library town holding fewest of that kind (ties to town order). A one-off: he may offer again while his regard holds. Placeholder prose.

body.text: I have a man who knows more about {param:resource} than anybody has a right to, and nothing to occupy him.
He would go out to you if I asked it. He likes a library, and I gather you have one; he would settle wherever there were fewest of his kind to argue with.
It would cost you nothing. I should simply like to think of him being useful.
It would cost you nothing, which I mention because I know how you are placed.

options.label: send him, and thank the man
options.text: Send him, and gladly. The colony has more use for a man who knows {param:resource} than for almost anything else you could have offered.

options.label: decline, with thanks
options.text: I would rather not take him from you. Keep him, with my thanks.
